subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand memorySearch beyond the shipped image/audio extraPaths subset, and should that expansion include persisted inbound attachments that users ask the agent to remember?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory modality config plus media retention and remote-upload behavior, which are product and security choices rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Split modality and attachment work
options.body: Add PDF/video extraPaths support under the existing opt-in multimodal contract, and handle remembered inbound attachments only after a separate consent, retention, deletion, and audit design is approved.

options.title: Limit to extraPaths only
options.body: Expand the current opt-in scanner to more file modalities but explicitly leave chat attachments out of durable memory for now.

options.title: Defer broad media memory
options.body: Keep the current image/audio subset and wait for a broader memory-plugin or media-retention roadmap before adding new core behavior.

recommendation.title: Split modality and attachment work
recommendation.body: Add PDF/video extraPaths support under the existing opt-in multimodal contract, and handle remembered inbound attachments only after a separate consent, retention, deletion, and audit design is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the shipped multimodal memory extraPaths feature and public config/docs boundary introduced through the existing multimodal memory work.
